name: Ravena
source:
A mysterious girl that helped [url=/c166917]Zack[/url] and [url=/c166918]Natasha[/url] make their way to Eden. She seems to be highly secretive of her past. However, she does not seem to have ill intentions. Members of the Church speak highly of her. She has a free spirit and hates the feeling of being confined. However, she finds a lot of peace within order.
